title: Knowledge, Observer & Spatial Discovery Runtime
objective: Implement true/observable/known/suspected spatial projections; observer/knowledge/memory/perception predicates; governed observation, experiment and hypothesis operations; role-safe route explanations; permission filtering before route/search/diagnostic model construction; evidence/knowledge handoffs to existing owners; and the owner-approved local-frame/orientation/discovered-identification knowledge model without allowing participant observation to rewrite canonical topology.
acceptance: True, observable, participant-known and participant-suspected projections remain distinct and carry explicit permission/basis versions.
Participants may hold incomplete or wrong maps/hypotheses without corrupting canonical topology truth.
Hidden topology nodes, edge counts, quotient identifications and solution structure are filtered before route/search/statistics/diagnostic/optional-AI contexts.
Observer, memory, knowledge and perception predicates consume owner-authorized state rather than client inference.
Local-frame/orientation knowledge and discovered quotient/identification knowledge are participant projections, not topology mutation.
Observation/experiment operations create governed evidence or knowledge proposals through existing owners.
Role-safe route explanations expose only authorized evidence and never reveal protected predicate truth.
Direct interactive play and summarized checks can both produce governed observations where the profile permits them.
Blocking discovery workflows remain semantic/nonvisual, keyboard-capable, provider-off and paid-cloud independent.
boundaries: MSLR-01/03 and upstream completed programs remain sealed.
Canonical topology and live spatial-law state remain MSLR runtime truth; participant-known/suspected projections cannot mutate them.
Knowledge/Visibility/Discovery owners retain participant knowledge, memory and authorization truth.
World/Reality/Scene/Location owners retain canonical identity and base location truth.
MCS retains map/projection presentation authority; participant maps may be wrong without becoming topology truth.
Local-frame/orientation/discovered-identification state in MSLR-04 is observer knowledge/projection state, not the MSLR-03 canonical topology state.
Hidden topology must be filtered before model construction rather than built privileged then relabeled.
MSLR-07 and later MSLR tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MSLR-04 closeout.
next_action: MSLR-04 is completed_verified. MSLR-07 — Reality-Seam, Temporal/Dream & Contextual Spatial Laws — is selected_not_started and awaits the next owner Continue.
